CS2106 prerequisite: CS2100. Completed. CS3219 prerequisite: CS2103T. Completed. CS3210 prerequisite: CS2100. Completed. CS3230 prerequisite: CS2040S and CS1231S. Completed. All prerequisites met. MC limits: Sem 4: 12 MC. Sem 7: 12 MC. All good. Wait, 'CS2102 before CS2106'. If CS2102 is in Sem 4 and CS2106 in Sem 6, this holds. 'CS3210 before CS2102'. The student said 'I need to finish CS3210 before I start CS2102'. CS3210 is in Sem 7. CS2102 is in Sem 4. Sem 7 is NOT before Sem 4. This is the conflict. CS3210 must be before CS2102. CS2102 must be in Sem < 6 (before CS2106 in Sem 6). So CS2102 must be in Sem 4 or 5. Sem 5 is NOC. So CS2102 must be in Sem 4. CS3210 must be before CS2102, so CS3210 must be in Sem < 4. Sem 4 is current. Sem 1-3 are past. Student has not completed CS3210. So CS3210 cannot be taken before Sem 4. Thus, CS3210 cannot be finished before CS2102 if CS2102 is in Sem 4. If CS2102 is in Sem 5 (NOC, 0 MC), it cannot be taken. So CS2102 MUST be in Sem 4. CS3210 MUST be before CS2102, so CS3210 MUST be in Sem < 4. But Sem < 4 are past. Student has not completed CS3210. Therefore, it is impossible to satisfy 'finish CS3210 before CS2102' and 'CS2102 in Sem 4' (or earlier). If CS2102 is in Sem 4, CS3210 must be in Sem 1-3. Not possible. If CS2102 is in Sem 5, it's NOC. Not possible. If CS2102 is in Sem 6, it violates 'before CS2106' (if CS2106 is Sem 6, 'before' usually means strictly earlier, but even if Sem 6, CS3210 must be before Sem 6, so Sem 4 or 5. Sem 5 is NOC. So CS3210 in Sem 4. But Sem 4 is full with CS2109S, CS2105, CS2102? No, if CS2102 is Sem 6, CS2109S/CS2105 are Sem 4. Sem 4: CS2109S, CS2105, CS3210. Sem 5: NOC. Sem 6: CS2102, CS2106. But 'CS2102 before CS2106'. If both Sem 6, is that 'before'? Usually no. Also 'CS2106 in Y3S2'. If CS2102 is also Y3S2, it's not before. If CS2102 is Y3S1 (Sem 5), it's NOC. So CS2102 cannot be before CS2106 if CS2106 is Sem 6, unless CS2102 is Sem 4 or 5. Sem 5 is NOC. So CS2102 must be Sem 4. Then CS3210 must be before Sem 4. Impossible. Thus, NO_PLAN.)
